name: BWild Low Grain All Breeds Adult

variants.name: Wild Boar 12 kg
variants.about_this_item: Monge Bwild Low Grain All Breeds Adult Dog Wild Boar is a complete and balanced pet food for adult dogs. The high animal protein content from wild boar meat guarantees a balanced diet, following the natural instinct of your animals. The recipe is formulated with low grain* level and it does not contains po tatoes. The linseed, source of fatty acids omega-3, supports a soft and shiny coat. The delicious taste is also enhanced by fruits (like blueberry, cranberry and raspberry) and vegetables (carrots), natural sources of fibre and minerals. The recipe is enriched with XOS (Xylo-oligosaccharide), last generation of prebiotics, which keep the intestinal wellness. The specific recipe ensures the animal’s well-being and respects its natural instinct. No added dyes and artificial preservatives. * Compare to standard product Monge (Special Dog Excellence Medium Adult Chicken).
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Dried wild boar meat (38%), animal fat 17% (lard purified at 99.5%), chicken fresh meat (10%), yellow peas, tapioca, rice (5%), oats (5%), dried beet pulp, hydrolysed animal proteins, minerals, brewers’ yeast, dried eggs (1%), linseed (1%), dried carrot (1%), dried tomato pulp (1%), pea fibre, yucca schidigera, spirulina, dried pineapple pulp, dried apple pulp, dried blueberries pulp 0.5% (equivalent to 4.3% fresh blueberries), dried cranberries pulp 0.5% (equivalent to 4.3% fresh cranberries), dried raspberries pulp 0.5% (equivalent to 4.3% fresh raspberries), Xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yeasts products (source of MOS), chondroitin sulphate, glucosamine, milk protein powder.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 29%, Crude fibre 2,5%, Crude fat:17%, Crude ash: 7%, Calcium: 1,00%, Phosphorus 0,90%, n-3 fatty acids: 0,70%, n-6 fatty acids: 3,00%, Metabolisable Energy: 4,150 kcal/k.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES / kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate): 28,000 IU, Vitamin D3: 1,700 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate): 570 mg, manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 32 mg): 10.4 mg, zinc (zinc oxide 105 mg): 84.3 mg, copper (copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 13 mg): 3.3 mg, iron (iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 110 mg): 36.2 mg, selenium (sodium selenite 0.2 mg): 0.09 mg, iodine (calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg): 1.17 mg, L-Carnitine 200 mg, DL-methionine technically pure 1,100 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and activity level of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is recommended to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Dog food only, not suitable for human consumption.
